_doc: A 5 mm to 8 mm flexible shaft coupler, the spiral-cut set-screw hobby part, from Adafruit's listing: community until measured. Listings of the same part disagree on its outside diameter (18 to 20 mm), and jaw couplers differ again, so measure yours before designing a clearance round it. Axis along z, the 5 mm side at z = 0.
